title: Privately Paid Held Bed Days in a Reconciled Estimate Month
content:
**Rule (Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage).** The first privately paid held day of a reconciled estimate month, reading the bed-hold reservation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations that the month's booked held days belong to: where that reservation is a hold whose every held day is the resident's own charge (a private-pay hold or a hold during a Medicare skilled stay), its leave start; where it is a Medicaid reserved bed whose private extension has begun, its private hold start; otherwise none (the first day of the next month), since the program pays the reserved days and patient pay is unchanged for them. The days of the month from that first day through the reservation's last held day (through the month's end where the bed is still held) are taken out and carry no cost.

| Reservation the month's booked held days belong to | First privately paid held day | Days taken out of the month |
|---|---|---|
| Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold or Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | its leave start | from the leave start (or the month's first day, if earlier) through the last held day, or the month's end if still held |
| Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold or Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | its leave start | the same span |
| Medicaid reserved bed whose private extension has begun | its private hold start | from the private hold start through the last held day, or the month's end if still held |
| Medicaid reserved bed with no private extension | none | none |
| no held day booked for the month | none | none |

*Hypothetical reading:* a Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed whose private extension began on day 13 of a 31-day month and whose last held day is day 16 — days 13 to 16, 4 days, are taken out. The same reservation without a private extension takes out no day.
